sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed by TigerGraph Sentinel on behalf of the Fraud Investigation Unit regarding an unauthorized wire transfer and account takeover involving customer CUST_8291 (Marcus Vance). On September 24, 2026, real-time telemetry detected an unauthorized outbound transfer in the amount of $4,850.00 USD under transaction TXN_782391. The transaction originated from an unverified IP address (197.210.64.12) located in Lagos, Nigeria, utilizing a proxy device DEV_293 (iPhone 15 Pro) exhibiting a hardware hash collision with TOR relay IP_94_102. This device and IP range had never previously appeared in Marcus Vance's three-year verified graph profile. GSQL multi-hop graph traversal identified that the outbound wire was routed toward mule syndicate accounts ACCT_4421 and ACCT_9923 with scheduled off-ramping into CRYPTO_EX. The customer was immediately contacted via out-of-band verification and explicitly denied authorizing the transaction or granting third-party credentials. Historical case memory matched the attack pattern with 89% semantic cosine similarity to precedent CASE_0872 (SIM-swap Wire Drain ring). The institution promptly declined the wire transfer, blocked all associated credentials, quarantined the recipient mule nodes, and submitted this filing in full accordance with FinCEN and Bank Secrecy Act requirements.
